title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
abstract: arXiv:2610.41599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.

translated_title: 具有Landauer边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优传输：机器学习与解析解
translated_abstract: 为欠阻尼随机过程寻找最优传输协议是控制理论中一个困难而又重要的问题。本文中，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于在非线性边界条件（包括模拟Landauer比特擦除问题的边界条件）存在的情况下找到该问题的最优解。动力学过程仅通过作用于一个可控的外部势场，在位置空间中从单峰分布被驱动到双峰分布。该问题高度非线性，通常情况下无法获得解析解。我们通过微扰展开对数值结果进行了基准验证，该微扰展开预期在适当的过阻尼极限下成立。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的直接方法，求解具有Landauer边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优传输问题，实现仅通过可控外部势场将单峰分布驱动为双峰分布，并利用过阻尼极限下的微扰展开验证了数值结果的正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a machine-learning-based direct method to solve underdamped stochastic optimal transport with Landauer boundary conditions, steering a single-peak to a double-peak distribution via a controllable external potential, with numerical results benchmarked against a perturbative expansion valid in the overdamped limit.
